title: W3Schools: Count List Occurrences
description: Given a list of integers `lst` and a `target` integer, return the number of times `target` appears in `lst`.
starter_code:
def count_in_list(lst: list[int], target: int) -> int:
    pass
solution:
def count_in_list(lst: list[int], target: int) -> int:
    return lst.count(target)
explanation: List method count() scans the list in O(N) time.
